privacy_intro: This page explains what ScoreGuide stores about you, who it is shared with, and how to delete it. ScoreGuide is run from Switzerland and follows the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nFADP) and, for visitors in the EU, the GDPR.
privacy_store_account: Your account: username, email address, and the optional first name, last name, instrument and description of your musical interests you give us. Your password is only stored as a secure hash; nobody can read it.
privacy_store_library: Your library: the PDFs you upload, the details of each score, your notes and annotations, how often you play each piece, and any table-of-contents corrections you send.
privacy_store_tech: Your IP address, used only to limit abuse (for example too many login attempts). It is not stored with your account.
privacy_where: Everything is hosted in Switzerland by Infomaniak: the server, the database, your PDF files, the emails we send and the AI assistant. The database is backed up daily; backups are encrypted and deleted after 30 days. Two services are outside Switzerland. Error reports go to Sentry (Functional Software Inc., USA; data stored in the EU, in Frankfurt): when something breaks, it receives the error, the page or request concerned and your browser type, but not your IP address or your files; reports are deleted after 90 days at most. The other is optional: YouTube's privacy-enhanced player (YouTube/Google, USA), which only loads when you click play on a video.
privacy_ai: The assistant runs on Infomaniak AI Services, in Switzerland. When you use it or ask ScoreGuide to complete a score's details, your question, your musical interests and the details of the relevant scores (title, composer, instrumentation and similar) are sent to it. Your PDF files are never sent. To complete a score's details, the AI can also search the web with DuckDuckGo; it is only given the piece's title and composer, so no personal data goes into those searches. Please don't type personal information into the assistant.
privacy_models_note: These are open models that Infomaniak runs on its own servers in Switzerland. According to Infomaniak, your requests are neither recorded nor used to train models or improve its services. We may change models; this list always shows the ones in use.
privacy_email: We only email you to confirm your address and to reset your password. No newsletters, no marketing.
privacy_cookies: ScoreGuide uses a login cookie and a language cookie, and stores your light/dark theme in your browser. There are no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and fonts are served from our own server.
privacy_share: Your data is never sold. It is only shared with the providers named above, to run the service, or when required by law.
privacy_rights: You can see and correct your details on your account page, and get a copy of all your data there with the “Download my data” button (a ZIP file with your account, scores, notes and PDFs). Deleting your account there removes your account, scores, notes and PDFs immediately; copies in backups disappear within 30 days. For any other request about your data, use the contact page or write to alexis.arnaudon@scoreguide.ch; we answer within 30 days. You can also complain to the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).
download_data_desc: Get a ZIP file with everything ScoreGuide stores about you: your account details, scores, sections, notes and annotations, AI usage, and your PDFs. It may take a moment for a large library.
legal_hosting: ScoreGuide and its data are hosted by Infomaniak Network SA, Geneva, Switzerland.
legal_content: The operator is responsible for the content of this site and takes care to keep it accurate, but cannot guarantee that it is complete or up to date. Score descriptions may be written with the help of AI and can contain mistakes. You are responsible for the PDFs and notes you add to your library.
